description: Coherent Gate + Leviathan (PAID, x402/USDC). Fetches the SML Leviathan signal (squeeze, momentum, or all) for a ticker, adds it as one path with your optional paths and registered sources, then runs the same coherence check as interfere: consensus, coherence 0-1, pass/block gate. Same tiers and billing as interfere ($0.25 max tier charged upfront; x402 difference recorded as owed, Arc rail captures only the used tier). If Leviathan is unavailable it continues on the other paths; with no paths it errors before charging. Max 32 paths. Not financial advice.

arc_auth_id.description: Arc rail: authId from AuthCaptureEscrow.authorize() for at least the max-tier amount to our receiver. Only the used tier is captured; the rest returns via reclaim() after expiry.

paths.description: Coherent Gate: extra signal paths (Leviathan adds one; total ≤ 32).

confidence.description: Weight 0-1 this path gets in the consensus.

direction.description: Direction this path calls: long, short, or flat.

source.description: Label for where this signal came from (1-64 chars).

signal_type.description: Which Leviathan signal to fetch and add as a path: squeeze, momentum, or all.

sources.description: Optional path-source ids added alongside Leviathan; default = all enabled verified sources.

name: leviathan_interfere
